HOW to heal your skin barrier 👇🏻 1.  STOP using harsh products. take a break from exfoliating acids, retinoids  (and other strong actives) 2. use a gentle LOW pH cleanser. avoid stripping your skin with harsh cleansers or washing it too often. and try to not cleanse in the morning 3. focus on hydration. use products with hyaluronic acid, glycerin, beta-glucan or panthenol. always apply them on a damp skin (so they can draw moisture) and “lock” them with a moisturizer  4. moisturize properly. look for ceramides, cholesterol, squalane, ectoin etc. to support your skin barrier 5. avoid over-exfoliating. give your skin time to recover instead of constantly using active ingredients 6. wear sunscreen every day. SPF 30–50 helps protect your skin while it recovers 7. eat clean whole foods. more healthy fats, fiber and protein!  8. stay hydrated throughout the day. this also prevents dehydrated skin  9. follow my page for more useful skincare tips 🤍 #skinbarrier #skincaresecret #skincarehacks #skincareroutine
